title: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Looking for people to grow in comics and illustration. OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV and portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portfolio). Open until positions are filled.

author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design project collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for an exhibition planned for early December at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, wordmark, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition print assets plus pre-press checks. Timeline Oct-Dec 2026. Want hand-drawn / Japanese / warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote. Contact: DM or comment on the Threads post.

title: Looking for Board Game Illustrators
content: Looking for Board Game Illustrators. Family strategy game (ages 8+), about 8-10 illustrations of Wild West themed animals. Family friendly art / children's book style. Poster notes this was posted by a client through HireCreativo; apply via https://hirecreativo.com/projects. Contact through that platform.
